findings.title: The page scrolls sideways under longWords
findings.measured: 161 px wider than the viewport (1440 px)
findings.expected: no horizontal scroll (WCAG 1.4.10 at 320 px)
findings.fix: find the widest element listed and let it wrap, shrink (min-width: 0, max-width: 100%) or scroll inside its own box

findings.title: Errors in the console
findings.measured: 2: Failed to fetch | Failed to fetch
findings.expected: no console errors while the page loads and scrolls
findings.fix: open the first error: a thrown error often leaves part of the page unrendered

findings.title: Requests failed or returned an error status
findings.measured: 4: GET http://127.0.0.1:8031/system/smart-ui/catalog.json net::ERR_FAILED | 500 http://127.0.0.1:8031/system/smart-ui/catalog.json | 500 http://127.0.0.1:8031/api/info
findings.expected: every request the page makes succeeds
findings.fix: a 404 on a font or image explains a fallback font or a broken picture

findings.title: Controls with no accessible name
findings.measured: 8 control(s): a.skip; od-chat.od-chat > div.od-chat-chips:nth-of-type(2) > button.od-chat-chip:nth-of-type(1); od-chat.od-chat > div.od-chat-chips:nth-of-type(2) > button.od-chat-chip:nth-of-type(2); od-chat.od-chat > div.od-chat-chips:nth-of-type(2) > button.od-chat-chip:nth-of-type(3)
findings.expected: every control has a name a screen reader can say
findings.fix: add aria-label, visible text, or a <label>

findings.title: Font weights one step apart
findings.measured: 400 on 30 element(s), 600 on 6 element(s), 700 on 2 element(s); 600 and 700 are one step apart, which can read as a mistake rather than a level
findings.expected: three weights at most in a system, and two in any one view, clearly apart, such as 400 and 600 (DC-L19-24; it marks two neighbouring weights reading as a mistake as inferred)
findings.fix: give each weight a job (body, labels, headings) and merge the near ones; try size or space before a third weight

findings.title: Lines longer than 80 characters
findings.measured: a.skip is about 143 characters wide
findings.expected: at most 80 (WCAG 1.4.8, AAA); 45-75 is the usual target
findings.fix: set max-width: 65ch on the text block

findings.title: Capitals with no tracking
findings.measured: 16 px at 0em, e.g. dl.facts > div:nth-of-type(3) > dd
findings.expected: capitals tracked open, about 0.06em
findings.fix: letter-spacing: var(--ds-text-label-sm-tracking) (0.06em)

findings.title: A heading, lede or label ends on one word
findings.measured: aside.side > section.card:nth-of-type(2) > p:nth-of-type(1) (lede): "Call 0300 555 0142, Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00." leaves "17:00." alone on line 2
findings.expected: no last line of a single word in headings, ledes and labels, at every width (preflight 39)
findings.fix: text-wrap: balance on headings and labels, text-wrap: pretty on ledes; or rewrite the line

findings.title: Padding smaller than the space between the items inside
findings.measured: div.layout:nth-of-type(2) > aside.side > section.card:nth-of-type(1): 20 px padding around items 30 px apart
findings.expected: the space inside a group at most the space around it (HOW-IT-WORKS section 7: inner spacing smaller than outer)
findings.fix: raise the padding to var(--ds-space-32) (32 px) or lower the gap to var(--ds-space-20) (20 px)

findings.title: Text runs out of its box under longWords
findings.measured: footer.foot > p (text): "Fernhollow is an invented council. Its people, pla" goes 65.42 px past a 375 px wide box
findings.expected: every line of text inside its own box, at 320 px, at 200% text and with longer words
findings.fix: let the text wrap: remove the fixed width or height and white-space: nowrap, set min-width: 0 on flex and grid children, and overflow-wrap: anywhere for long words

findings.title: A blank screen while the page loads on a slow network
findings.measured: 1 s into a throttled load (400 ms latency, 50 KB/s): no text and no loading sign; full load took 8538 ms
findings.expected: something on screen at once: the layout with a skeleton, or a loading sign
findings.fix: render the page frame first, then a skeleton the size of the content that is coming

findings.title: No loading sign while the data is on its way
findings.measured: 3 s into a request that has not answered: no skeleton, spinner, progress bar, aria-busy or "Loading" (914 characters on screen)
findings.expected: a skeleton the size of the content, or a loading sign, until the data arrives
findings.fix: render a skeleton for the view and set aria-busy on it until the data lands

findings.title: No message when the data is empty
findings.measured: 959 characters on screen and no new words for this state (requests answered this way: http://127.0.0.1:8031/api/info, http://127.0.0.1:8031/system/smart-ui/catalog.json)
findings.expected: an empty state that says there is nothing yet and what to do
findings.fix: write the state into the view: say what happened and offer the next step

findings.title: No message when the data is failing with a server error
findings.measured: 959 characters on screen and no new words for this state (requests answered this way: http://127.0.0.1:8031/api/info, http://127.0.0.1:8031/system/smart-ui/catalog.json)
findings.expected: an error that says what failed and offers a retry
findings.fix: write the state into the view: say what happened and offer the next step

findings.title: No message when the data is unreachable (offline)
findings.measured: 914 characters on screen and no new words for this state (requests answered this way: http://127.0.0.1:8031/api/info, http://127.0.0.1:8031/system/smart-ui/catalog.json)
findings.expected: a message that the connection is down, with a retry
findings.fix: write the state into the view: say what happened and offer the next step

findings.title: The not-found page offers no way on
findings.measured: 0 links on the page
findings.expected: a link home, to search or to the main sections
findings.fix: add the site header, or at least a link home

findings.title: The not-found page says a code, not what happened
findings.measured: heading: "Error response"
findings.expected: plain words: what happened and what to do
findings.fix: say it as a person would ("We can't find that page") and keep 404 as small print

findings.title: A missing name collapses its box
findings.measured: aside.side > section.card:nth-of-type(1) > h2 is 0 px tall with no text; dl.facts > div:nth-of-type(1) > dt is 0 px tall with no text; dl.facts > div:nth-of-type(2) > dt is 0 px tall with no text; dl.facts > div:nth-of-type(3) > dt is 0 px tall with no text
findings.expected: an empty name keeps the row or card the same height, or the product shows a fallback ("Untitled")
findings.fix: show a fallback name, or give the line a min-height of one line

findings.title: Button labels that do not start with a verb
findings.measured: od-chat.od-chat > div.od-chat-chips:nth-of-type(2) > button.od-chat-chip:nth-of-type(3): "When is the Hollow Lane office open?"; od-chat.od-chat > div.od-chat-chips:nth-of-type(2) > button.od-chat-chip:nth-of-type(5): "Where is my application?"; od-chat.od-chat > div.od-chat-chips:nth-of-type(2) > button.od-chat-chip:nth-of-type(6): "Can I get a visitor permit?"
findings.expected: a button says what it does: a verb first ("Compare prices", not "Pricing details")
findings.fix: start with the action; a word list decided this, so read each one

findings.title: Before launch: share image, favicon or indexing
findings.measured: missing a share image (og:image), a meta description
findings.expected: a public page has a share image, a favicon and a description; noindex only on drafts

findings.title: Controls placed outside the page box
findings.measured: a.skip
findings.expected: a skip link that appears on focus is fine; anything else is off-canvas content
findings.fix: Tab to it and confirm it appears

findings.title: Font weights outside the system's
findings.measured: weight 700 on 2 element(s); the system uses [400, 600]
findings.expected: the system's weights

findings.title: Hovering most sampled controls changes nothing you can see
findings.measured: 2 of 5: header.masthead > div.masthead-in > a.wordmark; div.masthead-in > p.who > a
findings.expected: a hover cue on pointer devices
findings.fix: confirm with a screenshot while hovering; touch-only products can skip this

findings.title: Look at the page with every image missing
findings.measured: 0 image(s) made to fail
findings.expected: cards and rows keep their size, and alt text or a placeholder says what was there
findings.fix: reserve the box (width and height or aspect-ratio) and give it a background
